> Score the pipeline you already have against the draft profile before adopting it.
 It is the fastest available test of whether the profile discriminates, it costs nothing, and it converts an abstract argument about definitions into a concrete list of deals people already have opinions about. If the in-profile and out-of-profile deals look equally healthy, the profile is not one.
